ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, our total leverage ratio was 1.69 to 1.0 which meant our ability at that date to make restricted payments was not limited.

Pursuant to the total leverage ratio financial maintenance covenant, the Company must maintain a total leverage ratio of not more than 5.0 to 1.0 with an ability in certain circumstances to temporarily increase that limit to 5.5 to 1.0 and a consolidated cash interest coverage ratio of not less than 2.50 to 1.0.

parsed.notes: The total leverage maintenance limit is 5.0x, which can be temporarily increased to 5.5x in certain circumstances. The separate 3.0x pro forma threshold only governs restricted payments such as dividends; it is not the maintenance limit. A secured net leverage ratio maintenance covenant is mentioned, but no actual value or limit is disclosed, so it is not listed. No actual interest coverage figure is disclosed. The total-debt-to-EBITDA pricing grid sets only the interest margin and is excluded.
